$pinnedPackagesComment: Optional packages installed INTO A PROFILE, not dependencies of the kit bundle. The bundle declares only what its own plugins import; these are mounted by lesson overlays, so their pins live in the profile manifests and are asserted by scripts/verify-target.sh.
